dialogues.speaker: Dragana
dialogues.text: Ow, the Lightkeepers' selection process is just too much. If only they'd count my sewing and mending abilities towards the assessment!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't think "sewing" and "Lightkeepers" really belong in the same sentence, though...

dialogues.speaker: Dragana
dialogues.text: You think...? That Ratnik in charge of the selection process must have thought the very same thing.

dialogues.speaker: Dragana
dialogues.text: But... someone has to mend the Lightkeeper uniforms that get torn and damaged in battle. So there are definitely ways I can be useful in moments like that...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Illuga</color> looks like he has something to say...?)

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Hey, Dragana, you're here. I hope I didn't keep the two of you waiting too long?

dialogues.speaker: Dragana
dialogues.text: No, not at all. But you look really busy. Are you taking good care of yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Yeah, don't worry, everything's fine on my end. Are you two here for the Lightkeepers' selections? How's that going?

dialogues.speaker: Dragana
dialogues.text: I think Paivio is close to being accepted. As for me... Ugh, seriously! It's one thing to lose out to you, Illuga, but to lose out to him as well... that would be truly embarrassing.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Oh, don't think like that, Dragana. You have talents in areas that neither Paivio nor I can ever match.

dialogues.speaker: Dragana
dialogues.text: Heh. Y'know, that does make me feel a lot better. I guess that means I need to start preparing for the next selection.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: That's right. And I'll be there to cheer you both on then.

dialogues.speaker: Dragana
dialogues.text: Well, if you're doing that, Paivio and I will have to pass the selection no matter what! We wouldn't want you to show up for nothing!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I wish you success!

dialogues.speaker: Dragana
dialogues.text: Thank you. I'll do my best.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm guessing people who sew, like you, must be really patient?

dialogues.speaker: Dragana
dialogues.text: Ah... So you're saying the patience needed for sewing and mending clothes is my real talent? That makes perfect sense... Huh. Why didn't I realize that sooner?

dialogues.speaker: Dragana
dialogues.text: As for my battle skills and all that... I'm lacking in that area now, sure. But as long as I stay determined and patient, I'll pass the selection one day.

dialogues.speaker: Dragana
dialogues.text: A Lightkeeper who's both good at fighting and a patient sort... Heh, look out, Piramida, here I come!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You know, there are so many different kinds of jobs out there...

dialogues.speaker: Dragana
dialogues.text: That's true, but I must become a Lightkeeper no matter what.

dialogues.speaker: Dragana
dialogues.text: I have to keep up, you see. My good friend is already a Lightkeeper, and my brother is probably about to become one too.

dialogues.speaker: Dragana
dialogues.text: Although I don't really have any combat skills to speak of... Ugh, Dragana, that's no excuse! No, you can do it!

dialogues.speaker: Dragana
dialogues.text: I must become someone who's really good at both sewing and battle by the time the next selection comes around!
